WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as baseline_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
matched_snapshots AS (
  SELECT 
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    s.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
combination_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    tradekind,
    AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM matched_snapshots
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
with_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.transref,
    ca.tradekind,
    ca.avg_optvolrt,
    ca.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_optvolrt as deviation
  FROM combination_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE b.baseline_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
type_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviations
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_combinations AS (
  SELECT 
    wd.tradekind,
    wd.avg_optvolrt,
    wd.deviation,
    wd.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation as excess
  FROM with_deviations wd
  INNER JOIN type_avg_deviations tad ON wd.tradekind = tad.tradekind
  WHERE wd.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation
),
final_results AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt_of_kept,
    AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation_of_kept,
    AVG(excess) as avg_excess_of_kept
  FROM filtered_combinations
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  avg_optvolrt_of_kept,
  avg_deviation_of_kept,
  avg_excess_of_kept
FROM final_results
ORDER BY tradekind;
